# Fetch content of all habit-tracker notes and parse them
import re

notes_data = []
for note in all_notes:
    note_detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note["note_id"])
    content = note_detail["content"]
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    match = re.search(r"(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})", note["title"])
    if not match:
        print(f"Warning: no date found in title: {note['title']}")
        continue
    date_str = match.group(1)
    # Parse content lines after header
    lines = content.splitlines()
    # Skip first line (header) and blank line
    habit_values = {}
    for line in lines[2:]:
        if ":" in line:
            habit, value = line.split(":", 1)
            habit = habit.strip()
            value = value.strip().lower()
            habit_values[habit] = value
    notes_data.append({"date": date_str, "habits": habit_values})

# Print first few to verify
print(f"Parsed {len(notes_data)} notes")
print(notes_data[0])

The rows should be sorted in ascending order of the date from top to bottom, and habit columns as per their order in logs.
